story: Kent Falls State Park is located in the town of Kent, Connecticut, within the Litchfield Hills region of the southern Berkshires. Established as a state park in 1919, it is home to a series of waterfalls on Falls Brook that drop 250 feet.
matters: The park features a tributary of the Housatonic River and encompasses 200 acres of land given by philanthropist Alain C. White.
name: Kent Falls State Park
